text: What moment with me this week would you relive if you could?
What is something I did lately that made you feel loved, even if it was small?
What do you wish we had ten more minutes for?
What is one thing you have been meaning to tell me but the day kept interrupting?
When did you feel closest to me recently?
What is one way I could make tomorrow easier for you?
Name one ordinary thing today that you are quietly grateful for.
What is something about our home that you love and rarely say out loud?
Who or what made your day a little lighter today?
What is a quality of mine you counted on this week?
What small luxury are you thankful for right now?
What did we survive together that you are glad is behind us?
If we had one completely free weekend next month, how would you want to spend it?
What is a place you want us to wake up in together someday?
What is something you want to learn or try this year, just for you?
Describe an ordinary Tuesday five years from now that would make you happy.
What is one tradition you would love us to start?
If money and calendars vanished for one evening, what would we do tonight?
Rate today as a movie genre. Which one, and why?

What song should be playing the next time I walk through the door?
What is your current controversial food opinion?

What took more out of you today than it should have?
